owner_direction: Preserve the FULL Sky Lagoon setting: both water areas, playground, landing area and the route to Pearl Castle, with the full native panorama and original prop spacing. No otter. Part 2 print preparation is held until owner illustration acceptance.
applicable_rules: Current V41 Part1 B1/B2 and the explicit Part1-to-Part 2 owner stop

packet_integrity.method: Packet documents checked against their declared publication bytes; other references checked against canonical committed bytes at f55c094cfde2c1722eb210c74f85b868a4158ce9, as the handoff manifest specifies.

V40_review_failure.conclusion: The prior independent visual judgment missed a material loss of setting identity. Source seals, recognizable objects and correct wheel/bridge joins did not establish a good arrival scene.
omissions: The x1250..4117 crop retained only 2867 of 6144 native horizontal pixels, omitting both water areas and the left rope-post shore/landing approach. The picture named Sky Lagoon while showing no lagoon.

The original long left-to-right journey, meadow spacing, right shoreline and mountain approach were replaced by a compact row of plane, playground and castle. Familiar objects no longer communicated the location's geographic context.

The review accepted a declared condensed book layout without establishing whether condensing preserved the owner's intended place. Declaring the transformation did not make that visual result successful.

Attention went to small matte/contact repairs, numerical source continuity and unchanged pages. The review needed an earlier whole-scene comparison to the approved full setting and a test of what setting facts disappeared.
Current castle source/layout authority was not made a hard compositional reference; a prior castle card and relocated bridge were accepted because they were recognizable.
V40_review_failure.accountability: I had inspected the full panorama and noted that exact spacing would not fit a full-height 7:5 crop, but did not turn preservation of the setting into an acceptance condition. The owner's rejection supersedes my prior V40 candidate satisfaction. Historical machine and publication checks remain truthful byte evidence; they do not defend the rejected design.
V40_review_failure.change_to_review_method: Start each new visual review with source-versus-page context: what place, route, water, action and relationships survive. Only then inspect identity, contacts, joins and mechanical seals. A perfect checksum cannot substitute for a useful scene.

full_setting_hard_checks.requirement: Retain the complete 6144 x 2048 native panorama, x0 through 6144 and y0 through 2048. Only one uniform scale and vertical translation may place this world in the 7:5 page. No horizontal crop, stretch, condensed spacing, fade or hidden replacement of source context.
full_setting_hard_checks.evidence: Compare the exact native world strip before and after page assembly; verify original plate pixels outside declared source-card alpha footprints.

full_setting_hard_checks.requirement: Both water areas must remain visibly identifiable at 7 x 5: the left pool with its complete authored rope-post shore, and the right lagoon/shoreline around the native castle. Merely retaining water underneath an oversized opaque card is insufficient.
full_setting_hard_checks.evidence: Whole-page visual review plus original-water/rope-post visibility overlays; only legitimate native-card occlusion is allowed.

full_setting_hard_checks.requirement: Preserve the original stone route continuously from the left arrival area past the playground to the castle landing. Preserve its turns, shoreline relationship and clear approach, rather than painting a shorter connection.
full_setting_hard_checks.evidence: Original source route and its native sampled path remain geometrically aligned and visually traceable. The mountain path remains clear.

full_setting_hard_checks.requirement: Use the current four-tower castle card and exact sky_lagoon_layout.json scale/bridge-bearing anchor. All four towers, Roshan glass, doorway and complete bridge remain visible and supported at the right shoreline.
full_setting_hard_checks.evidence: Anchor/support calculation and actual shore/bridge close-up; whole-page tower and water visibility.

full_setting_hard_checks.requirement: Keep native playground rest positions and scale: slide at [2550,1400], height 620; swing frame at [3200,1390], height 480; seesaw at [3826,1500], height 265. Preserve separation, source aspect ratios, fixture supports and an attached single swing seat.
full_setting_hard_checks.evidence: Static source layout from sky_lagoon_promenade.gd, declared transforms and actual final visual relationships. A small declared seat fit is not permission to move or condense the playground.

full_setting_hard_checks.requirement: Keep the actual plane and source wheels in the left landing area. The silhouette must remain complete, with no otter, painted-over foliage, detached gear or falsely claimed stone contacts. Both tyre contacts and their shadows must be judged against the actual path pixels.
full_setting_hard_checks.evidence: Native source matte/RGB equality plus an enlarged contact view and the ordinary full page. Source equality alone cannot prove support.

full_setting_hard_checks.requirement: Extend only sky above and foreground below to fit7:5. The complete world must be restored unchanged after any generated extension; generated pixels cannot enter its native core or create new buildings, paths, pools, props or characters.
full_setting_hard_checks.evidence: Exact core comparison, separate extension masks/native dimensions/provenance, and visual checks at both seams.

full_setting_hard_checks.requirement: Review the entire7x5-equivalent page after the extensions and caption are present. Water, landing, playground, castle and connecting route must all read as one place; the full-width scene cannot be accepted solely because a small unchanged strip exists inside a mostly empty or unrelated page.
full_setting_hard_checks.evidence: Context-first visual critique at actual reading size, not only a giant native close-up or checksum. Do not recover readability by cropping/condensing the world again.

full_setting_hard_checks.requirement: Retain exact manuscript, caption controls,34-page sequence, covers and all pages outside the authorized story2/story 5 scope, with existing source and owner holds intact.
full_setting_hard_checks.evidence: Final exact control and proof comparisons; five fresh focused primary reviews and separate independent critique of the exact final candidate.

visual_observations: The full-width draft restores both water areas and the complete left rope-post approach. The arrival plane sits in the left part of the setting rather than beside an artificially moved castle.
Slide, swing and seesaw occupy the original separated meadow. The broad route, distant mountain houses/trail and right lagoon remain visible.
The current four-tower castle is recognizably the native shoreline destination, and its bridge meets the authored stone approach.
This is materially more faithful to Sky Lagoon's geographic context than V40. That judgment is based on the actual scene, not merely its source hash.

issue.evidence: In a native review crop x860..1450,y1490..1705, the main tyre ends on the flat grass verge below the curved path while the nose tyre is on stone. Both are ground-supported, but the draft provenance says the plane/wheels are on the original stone landing path.
issue.recommendation: Move the complete plane and associated shadows upward roughly 45–60 native pixels, then inspect the exact path edge/contact again. Preserve left landing-area geography and source plane/wheel pixels. A coordinate change alone is not acceptance.

first_full_world_draft.pending: Generated top/bottom extensions, actual captioned book proof, native join review and B1 candidate are not reviewed by this diagnostic.

B1_dust.method_authority_note: The audit does not spell out its mask threshold or aggregation code. Independently, max RGB delta>6 and contrast of mean linear luminances reproduce its exact 2,326 pixel count,0.1111 in strip and rounded 1.44 contrast. This is a disclosed reconstruction of the audit method, not a claim that its original code was supplied.

frozen_acceptance_calculation.comparison: Final rendered story 5 RGB PNG versus exact V37 page 05 RGB PNG, using the same 1512 x 1080 rendering.
frozen_acceptance_calculation.height: Inclusive bounding-box height of that mask divided by 216 pixels/inch.
frozen_acceptance_calculation.luminance: sRGB channel/255; linearize at 0.04045 using channel/12.92 or((channel+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; combine 0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B.
frozen_acceptance_calculation.contrast: For changed pixels selected by the fixed mask, compute mean final linear luminance and mean V37 linear luminance, then(max(mean_final,mean_baseline)+0.05)/(min(mean_final,mean_baseline)+0.05).
frozen_acceptance_calculation.forbidden_substitution: Do not replace contrast-of-means with the easier mean of per-pixel contrast ratios, silently raise the pixel-difference threshold, or count dust alpha/native height instead of the actual changed page pixels.

qualitative_requirements: Four soft shapeless lavender-grey wisps, roughly doubled core height and stronger opacity/lightness using dusty Puff's established colour; no eyes, spirals, pearls or star.
One wisp spills forward across the front edge of the top red step and clearly emerges from the closed threshold.

Preserve original door architecture/straight moulding and all surrounding stationery, words and banks. Alpha-only dust contours may touch the door; no backing rectangle, halo or repainted architecture.
At7x5, the clue must be easy to notice without a locator overlay. The bounding-height target cannot be satisfied by a few almost invisible outlier pixels while the four wisps remain faint.
Independent AI visibility inspection is not evidence of an unprompted child or general reader noticing the clue; keep that acceptance limitation honest.

B2_and_Part2.B2: No page 9 drawing changes and no third bath take. Preserve V37 source drawing and exact page 9 proof. The handoff's no-new-attempt decision is authorized.
B2_and_Part2.A9_disposition: Distinguish the decision that no new drawing is needed for the chosen 11 in trim from acceptance of a not-yet-built print output. No new print-quality evidence or general source-resolution approval is invented.
